mechanism_narrative: The sharp decline in WORKPLACES mobility in the most recent week, following a period of slight recovery, signals the implementation or reinforcement of restrictions that will reduce non-essential movement and depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the average of the last 28 days, despite the significant drop in WORKPLACES mobility.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than the average of the last 14 days, despite the observed increase in PARKS mobility.

candidate_trigger: TRANSIT mobility remains below -30% from baseline for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days increases, despite TRANSIT mobility remaining significantly below -30% from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Despite stable GROCERY_PHARM mobility indicating consistent essential activity, the persistent low levels of RETAIL_REC suggest a continued prioritization of essential over non-essential spending and activities, which will keep RETAIL_REC suppressed over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The overall average of RETAIL_REC mobility remaining significantly below baseline over the last four weeks indicates a deeply entrenched pattern of reduced non-essential activity, which will persist and keep RETAIL_REC low over the next four weeks.
